Repair03 adds AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03: instantaneous effects are checked at their actual origin and recipient/area/destination manifestation checkpoints. An outside cast whose local payload would manifest inside is suppressed there after cost; outside-to-outside nonpath travel remains unaffected. Exact dispels may address the Antimagic application itself through a narrow self-dispel exception. Spell Preservation keeps its permanent nonartifact destruction protection while magical usability is suppressed.

Repair03 adds AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03. A cross-plane transition snapshots prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the actual origin immediately before transit; arrival wards evaluate that immutable prospective value before placement, and commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey only on successful atomic transit.

Repair03 adds AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 and AC5-WALL-PANELS-03. Alignment Portal gets fixed aperture pose, two-way physical crossing, squeeze/difficult movement costs, exact nonteleport planar classification, forced-crossing handling and destination support. Planar Protection cannot create support: continuous unsupported Falling is not arrested. Wall resumption uses fixed 2.5-foot panels and never cuts/pushes an occupant.

Repair03 expands AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 with ACCEPT/RESIST intent, Banishment-only planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, BAN-ADMIT-03/current-cell geometry reuse and full closure of every extant secondary body/corpse/object when the primary finite source ends.

Repair03 adds AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03: at most one pending Binding order per binder→target record, binding the next real target behavior opportunity and expiring after it. New valid orders replace older pending Binding orders; suppression can make the opportunity ineffective without banking it. Plane separation blocks new issuance but not an already-heard order. Companion gates remain mandatory.

Repair03 clarifies Barrier concentration transition and price buckets. Same-caster recast ends the old Barrier at commitment before comparison. A different-caster equal/weaker offer does not replace the retained pool and its fresh application/concentration ends at resolution. Price accounting explicitly separates creditable base, noncreditable pre-Nexus extras, Dampening/final Influence, and protected X.
